data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reports a gross release in prior-year claims reserves of GBP 13.638m in 2015 (opening gross claims outstanding GBP 95.746m at 1 Jan 2015). The movement is described as a favourable movement (net GBP 13.7m) and is primarily attributed to favourable claims development and expected reinsurance recoveries across multiple classes (notably property/fire and reinsurance lines). Per-class figures are presented net of reinsurance; no single large named prior-year catastrophe is identified as driving the movement.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 13.7 million, (2014: GBP 8.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (Technical provisions) 2014 comparative column (page 13). Prior-year development gross figure taken from Technical provisions reconciliation note 'Change in prior year provisions' (gross) as (13,638)k on page 40 (confidence 1.0). Note 7 on page 33 reports 'Favourable movements of GBP 13.7 million... net of expected reinsurance recoveries' and provides a per-class breakdown which is NET of reinsurance - the per-LOB amounts in lob_movements are derived from that net table (hence lower confidence for mapping to gross movements). Where per-LOB figures were only available net of reinsurance, these have been included but flagged. The claims development triangle is present (page 39) and was used as secondary verification; no explicit named prior-year catastrophe events are mentioned in the notes provided.
